scope: Finite weighted three-pair preflop betting with hidden full-board forced checkdown, exactly the max_raises=1 game independently certified in PR152. No later-street betting, full-range, multiway or unrestricted accuracy claim.

traces.scope: Separate complete-call Python tracemalloc, excludes native child allocation and RSS; no memory-saving gate.

timing_boundary: Complete prepared solver call plus canonical JSON UTF-8 serialization and SHA256. Input loading, source/build checks, wrappers and independent validation remain outside timing. Every raw policy and failed observation is retained. No general speedup, monotonic convergence or process memory claim.
admission: All twelve full-request Python/reference and native preflights, including both trace requests, finish before native executable lookup or training. Existing complete-solve, structural and source guards stay unchanged.
method: Independently reverify the saved exact rational witness, replay every saved finite strategy using independent numeric rules and pinned physical counts, and check exact best-response brackets against that proved value. No rowwise policy match to one chosen equilibrium is required.
